purpose: Prevent territory coverage from becoming green by accepting fuzzy identities, historical fares, inferred reverse fares, or geographic interpolation that is not explicitly governed.

cases.reason: The published unlisted-destination provision is not implemented until deterministic governed road-order geography exists.

Historical web reproductions must not override the 2022-10-24 schedule.
STX 1-or-2 pricing is one group total, not the per-person STT/STJ model.
A destination row must not create a reverse quote merely through generic rule reversal.

passRule: All cases must pass against the governed matcher before negativeFailClosedTestsComplete may become true.
